source: Copernicus Sentinel-2 L2A via Element84 Earth Search (STAC) and the Sentinel-2 COGs on AWS Open Data. Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data.
method: Per month, up to 3 scenes that see at least 30% of the area without cloud (Sentinel-2 scene classification: cloud, cirrus, cloud shadow, dark and no-data pixels removed), per-pixel median. A month is reported only if at least 60% of the area was seen clear. built_pct: share of clear pixels with NDBI > 0.00 and NDVI < 0.25 (built-up OR bare ground: at 10 m a cleared plot and a concrete slab look alike). new_built_since_baseline_pct: pixels that were not built-up or bare in the baseline month and are now. Frames: months at least 80% clear.
